scenes.title_cn: 开场：今天做一个小实验，用同样瓦数的…
scenes.title_en: Opening: today a little experiment—same wa…
sentences: 今天做一个小实验，用同样瓦数的闪光灯和常亮灯，看看它们亮度差多少。
Today a small experiment—same wattage flash vs continuous light, to see the brightness gap.
brightness gap（亮度差距）
结果可能会让你意外。
The result may surprise you.
may surprise you（可能意外）
scenes.speak: Today a small experiment—same wattage flash vs continuous light, to see the brightness gap. The result may surprise you.

scenes.title_cn: 实验设置：把闪光灯和常亮灯都调到相同…
scenes.title_en: Setup: set both lights to the same wattage…
scenes.context: 固定参数对比两种光源。
sentences: 把闪光灯和常亮灯都调到相同瓦数。
Set both lights to the same wattage.
same wattage（同瓦数）
以闪光灯为基准测光：ISO100、快门1/200秒。
Meter the flash as the baseline: ISO 100, shutter 1/200s.
flash as baseline（闪光灯为基准）
常亮灯是持续发光的，所以要用不同的测光逻辑。
Continuous light is steady, so the metering logic differs.
steady light（持续发光）
paraphrase: flash as baseline（闪光灯为基准
flash as baseline（闪光灯为基准
scenes.speak: Set both lights to the same wattage. Meter the flash as the baseline: ISO 100, shutter 1/200s. Continuous light is steady, so the metering logic differs.

scenes.title_cn: 结果分析：在相同参数下，闪光灯的曝光…
scenes.title_en: Results: at identical settings, the flash …
scenes.context: 瞬时能量释放是差距根源。
sentences: 在相同参数下，闪光灯的曝光效果明显比常亮灯亮得多。
At identical settings, flash exposure is far brighter.
far brighter（亮得多）
这是因为闪光灯在一瞬间把所有能量释放出来。
Flash dumps all its energy in an instant.
dump energy instantly（瞬间释放能量）
同等瓦数下，闪光灯的有效光量可以高出常亮灯几个数量级。
At equal wattage, flash's effective light can exceed by orders of magnitude.
orders of magnitude（数量级）
scenes.speak: At identical settings, flash exposure is far brighter. Flash dumps all its energy in an instant. At equal wattage, flash's effective light can exceed by orders of magnitude.

scenes.title_cn: 为什么日常中感觉不到：平时用常亮灯感…
scenes.title_en: Why you don't notice daily: continuous lig…
scenes.context: 人眼适应掩盖了物理差距。
sentences: 平时用常亮灯感觉也很亮，是因为人眼自动适应亮度。
Continuous light feels bright because your eyes auto-adapt.
auto-adapt（自动适应）
相机曝光只看物理光量，不看人眼的适应。
The camera meters physical light, not adaptation.
physical light（物理光量）
拍视频觉得够亮，一拍照片发现常亮灯明显暗。
Looks fine for video, but clearly dim in a photo.
video vs photo（视频vs照片）
scenes.speak: Continuous light feels bright because your eyes auto-adapt. The camera meters physical light, not adaptation. Looks fine for video, but clearly dim in a photo.

scenes.title_cn: 总结与选择：买灯之前先想清楚你的用途…
scenes.title_en: Summary and choice: think about your use b…
sentences: 买灯之前先想清楚你的用途。
Think about your use before buying a light.
know your use（明确用途）
拍视频选常亮灯，所见即所得。
Video: continuous light, WYSIWYG.
WYSIWYG（所见即所得）
拍照片追求画质和光效，选闪光灯。
Photos chasing quality: flash.
flash for photos（拍照用闪光灯）
没有谁更好，只有适不适合。
Neither is better, only more fitting.
only fitting（只有适合）
scenes.speak: Think about your use before buying a light. Video: continuous light, WYSIWYG. Photos chasing quality: flash. Neither is better, only more fitting.

practice: Set both lights to the same wattage.
Flash is orders of magnitude brighter.
Eyes auto-adapt, the camera meters physics.
Video picks continuous, photos pick flash.
pitfalls: Judge light by how bright it looks.
Meter physical light, not the eye's adaptation.
相机看物理光量，人眼会自动适应。
Expect video lights to fit photography.
Same wattage flash dwarfs continuous in stills.
拍视频够亮的灯，拍照会明显偏暗。
Flash dumps energy instantly, LED radiates steadily.
同瓦数有效光量差几个数量级。
Buy a light without a use case.
Know your use: WYSIWYG or freeze power.
shifts: 用 wattage（瓦数）、effective light（有效光量）、orders of magnitude（数量级）
用 auto-adapt（自动适应）、physical light（物理光量）
用 WYSIWYG（所见即所得）、freeze power（凝固力）、use case（用途）
